vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 4todo
Version: 0.1.3

The skill is designed to manage 4todo (4to.do) tasks via its API using `curl`. All instructions in `SKILL.md` and `references/api_v0.md` consistently direct API calls to `https://4to.do/api/v0`. The skill explicitly instructs the agent on secure handling of the `FOURTODO_API_TOKEN` environment variable, advising against pasting secrets into prompts or logs, which is a strong indicator of security-conscious design. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution (e.g., `curl|bash`), persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts to subvert the agent's core purpose or access unrelated sensitive data.
